principle: These probes test Model Connect input handling and TRT-vs-reference contract parity, not model accuracy.
recommended_metrics: CER for ASR-specific character-level transcript parity
WER substitution/insertion/deletion breakdown for ASR failure triage
no-speech/blank-audio state reporting for future ASR contract work

cases.purpose: Current smoke input copied as baseline.
cases.model_connect_path: WAV decode + stereo input + model-specific resample.
cases.contract_oracle: Compare TRT transcript with reference backend transcript; do not judge model accuracy.
cases.notes: Expected transcript is the existing short weather sentence.

cases.model_connect_path: WAV decode without model-side downmix; should avoid 48k->16k resample in ASR preprocessing.
cases.contract_oracle: Compare TRT transcript with reference backend transcript; do not judge model accuracy.
cases.notes: Useful to isolate resampling differences from core decode/runtime differences.

cases.model_connect_path: WAV decode + 48k->16k resample, without stereo downmix.
cases.contract_oracle: Compare TRT transcript with reference backend transcript; do not judge model accuracy.
cases.notes: Separates resample handling from stereo downmix handling.

cases.purpose: Cover stereo-to-mono with asymmetric channel levels.
cases.model_connect_path: Stereo downmix should be robust when L/R channels are not identical.
cases.contract_oracle: Compare TRT transcript with reference backend transcript; do not judge model accuracy.
cases.notes: Still the same speech content; intended to catch channel handling mistakes.

cases.model_connect_path: PCM int16 decode + float normalization + ASR preprocessing.
cases.contract_oracle: Compare TRT transcript with reference backend transcript; do not judge model accuracy.
cases.notes: Reference and TRT should see the same low-volume input.

cases.purpose: Cover non-speech padding around valid speech.
cases.model_connect_path: Longer waveform decode + silence handling + transcript stability.
cases.contract_oracle: Compare TRT transcript with reference backend transcript; do not judge model accuracy.
cases.notes: Detects unexpected trimming, transcript drift, or EOS issues.

cases.model_connect_path: PCM decode + preprocessing under non-clean waveform.
cases.contract_oracle: Compare TRT transcript with reference backend transcript; do not judge model accuracy.
cases.notes: Use only as TRT-vs-reference parity; do not evaluate model noise robustness.
